chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ali al-'Alawi, from Sahl ibn Jumhur, from 'Abd al-'Azim ibn 'Abd Allah al-Hasani, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-'Urani, from 'Ali ibn Hashim, from his father, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
It would not harm the one who dies awaiting our matter that he did not die in the midst of the tent of al-Mahdi and his army.

key_terms.الْمَهْدِيِّ: al-Mahdi, the guided Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.لِأَمْرِنَا: for our matter; the cause and command associated with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.مَا ضَرَّ: it did not harm or disadvantage

ai.seo_question: Does a believer lose reward if he dies before the appearance of al-Mahdi عليه السلام while awaiting him?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the believer who remains in a state of waiting for the command of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام loses nothing if death overtakes him before the manifest rise of al-Mahdi عليه السلام. Its significance lies in affirming the spiritual rank of sincere intizar even if one does not physically live to join al-Mahdi عليه السلام and his army.
